title: Velvety Sweet Venezuelan Chocolate Mousse
description: A romantic Venezuelan dessert featuring tempered chocolate and icing sugar, this mousse is a low-fat friendly treat with a glassy-jelly texture, made possible by fermenting the chocolate mixture.
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler, stirring occasionally, until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg whites and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, whisk together the icing sugar and water until dissolved.
Add the vanilla extract to the icing sugar mixture and whisk to combine.
Allow the chocolate to cool slightly, then fold it into the egg white mixture until well combined.
Fold the icing sugar mixture into the chocolate mixture until smooth.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Before serving, allow the mousse to come to room temperature for 30 minutes.
Garnish with additional icing sugar, if desired.
